purpose: Teach: 伐採/急性/海峡/激怒/不条理/醸造/戦艦/着工

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、森林伐採による環境影響を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Sakura, I see you were writing about the environmental impact of deforestation.
lines.style: Warm, observational tone. Opening with her name as a gentle anchor. Soft, encouraging cadence. Not interrogating—acknowledging what she's accomplished. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、急性疾患の早期発見を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about early detection methods for acute diseases.
lines.style: Direct but not defensive. Slight pause after the yes—she's used to being misheard, so she's careful with clarity. Measured delivery, respectful of the teacher's attention.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 津軽海峡の漁業史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: And I noticed you covered the fishing history of Tsugaru Strait.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. Slight pause before 'I noticed'—she's recalling, not reading. Genuine interest beneath the formal structure. Calm tempo.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、抑圧された人々の激怒を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the rage of oppressed communities.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching. No apology in the voice. She's confident in her subject matter. Slight emphasis on 'examined'—this was rigorous work. Meeting the teacher's gaze.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 社会の不条理を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: Your paper on the absurdities within society was quite compelling.
lines.style: Genuine warmth underneath. Not flattery—actual recognition. Slight lean forward in the voice. She's saying something real and wants Sakura to hear it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、伝統的な醸造文化を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on traditional fermentation practices and their cultural significance.
lines.style: Engaged now, not just answering. A thread of real interest enters. She's relaxing slightly—the teacher actually gets what she's doing. Voice has more dimension.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 旧海軍の戦艦の歴史を論文で扱っていましたね
lines.en: I see you also researched the history of the Imperial Navy's battleship programs.
lines.style: Calm, reflective. She's moving through this with genuine curiosity, not running a checklist. Slight rising lilt at the end—inviting Sakura to share more if she wants to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、新幹線の着工史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I traced the origins and construction timeline of the Shinkansen project.
lines.style: Final answer carries quiet satisfaction. Not rushed. She's earned this moment of being truly heard. Voice lands with gentle finality, almost a close to a conversation gone right.
